newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks end lower on finance share slump.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks end lower on finance share slump.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed slightly lower on Monday due to retail selling of two highly-capitalised finance blue chips, but trading in the overall market was flat because of poor liquidity, brokers said.

The all share index closed 0.75 points lower at 729.45 points. Price gains outnumbered declines by 35 to 27. Blue chips Development Finance fell three rupees to 267 rupees, National Development Bank 3.25 to 217.
"Retailers had the run of the market," said Gordon Nadesan of bokerage CT Smith. "It was not possible to conclude many big buy orders because sellers were holding out for premiums".
